task_fulfillment.rationale: Both Word deliverables substantially address the request and support Vendrax with consistent base-case comparisons. Material corrections remain: the switching analysis compares standalone supplier totals but omits the retained, already-paid Juvoxa tooling/R&D from the replacement scenario. Assuming INR 12 Mn was paid, Vendrax's incremental transition cost versus continuing Juvoxa is INR 306.39 Mn before refund and INR 302.79 Mn after refund, not INR 294.39/290.79 Mn. The report also introduces prohibited numerical FX scenarios. The email asserts specific contractual obligations without a supplied contract; clause placeholders do not verify those assertions. Page counts remain unverified, not failed. Missing summary structure and transposed table presentation are not independently material fulfillment failures.
